completion_promises.criterion_text: TTL values applied correctly (null = no TTL, persistent)

Tests verify: TestKvBucketTtlValues (8 tests) checking each bucket's TTL value, TestKvBucketTtlProvisioning (3 tests) checking script handles null TTL and conditional --ttl flag.
